songTitle: Trying to Fit In (Rehearsals in the Mirror)

scenes.name: Rehearsals in the Mirror
scenes.subtitle: Warm fingerpicked acoustic guitar • Practicing expressions in front of the mirror

scenes.name: Two Beats Late & Cold Cup
scenes.subtitle: Laughing two beats late • Checking reflection in a cold paper cup

lines.text: Laughing two beats late at jokes I barely understand,
Checking my reflection with a cold cup in my hand.

scenes.name: Bitter Drink & Walking Confident
scenes.subtitle: Ordering bitter coffee to look mature • Walking in pretending to be sure

lines.text: Ordering the bitter drink because it looks mature,
Walking in the room like I was confident and sure.

scenes.name: Rear-View Mirror & Hallway Door
scenes.subtitle: Practicing hello in the mirror • Staring at the phone screen in the hallway

lines.text: Practicing my hello in the rear-view mirror twice,
Memorizing playlist tracks to seem easy and nice.
Standing by the hallway door, staring at my screen,
Terrified they'll see the boy behind the magazine.

scenes.name: Trying So Hard Just to Fit In
scenes.subtitle: Trading every honest piece of who I've been • Laughing right on cue

lines.text: I’ve been trying so hard to fit in,
Trading every honest piece of who I’ve been.
Nodding at the things they say, laughing right on cue,
Tell me, if I let it slip—would they want me too?
Yeah, trying so hard just to fit in...
Trying so hard just to fit in.

scenes.name: Untying Sneakers & Quiet Bedroom
scenes.subtitle: Locking the door and letting the smile drop • Silence feels like breathing

lines.text: Untying my sneakers as I finally lock the door,
Letting all the practiced smiles crumble to the floor.
Silence in my bedroom feels like breathing for the first time,
No lines to remember, no awkward hill to climb.

scenes.name: Shaking Hands & Did It Work Tonight
scenes.subtitle: Wondering if hands were shaking • Or if the version of me did its job

lines.text: I wonder if they noticed that my hands were shaking slight,
Or if the version of me did its job tonight.

scenes.name: Chorus Reprise • The Cost of Fitting In
scenes.subtitle: Trading every honest piece • If I let it slip, would they want me?

lines.text: I’ve been trying so hard to fit in,
Trading every honest piece of who I’ve been.
Nodding at the things they say, laughing right on cue,
Tell me, if I let it slip—would they want me too?
Yeah, trying so hard just to fit in...
Trying so hard just to fit in.

scenes.name: A Seat at Every Table
scenes.subtitle: What if I stopped running for a seat? • Is it love if it's the costume they choose?

lines.text: What if I stopped running for a seat at every table?
What if I stopped pretending that I’m always strong and able?
If I show up ordinary, quiet, slightly bruised...
Is it really love if it’s the costume that they choose?

scenes.name: No More Trying • Choosing Myself
scenes.subtitle: Picking up the pieces beneath my skin • Without a hidden clause

lines.text: No more trying so hard to fit in,
I’m picking up the pieces from beneath my skin.
I don't need the spotlight or a chorus of applause,
I just want to be myself, without a hidden clause.
No more trying so hard to fit in...

scenes.name: Learning How to Breathe
scenes.subtitle: Just an ordinary guy • Learning how to breathe again

lines.text: Just an ordinary guy... Learning how to breathe again.
